description: Token contract inspector for Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum and Polygon: is it a contract, ERC20/ERC721/ERC1155 detection, name, symbol, decimals, total supply (raw and formatted), owner, and upgradeable-proxy check (EIP-1967, beacon, EIP-1167 clone, legacy zeppelinos) with implementation and admin addresses. Read live from public RPC. Use before quoting, swapping, listing or paying with a token. Price $0.002 USDC per call via x402.
